title: NIFTY Smallcap 250 P/E Ratio
description: The NIFTY Smallcap 250 P/E ratio today is 31.2 as of 23 Oct, 2026, against a 10-year median of 31.8. Smallcap valuations move furthest in both directions because the segment is the most sensitive to domestic flows, which makes the gap against the median a practical gauge of how stretched sentiment has become.
